display.purpose: Page hero headlines only. One per page maximum.

headline.purpose: Blog post titles in listings. The workhorse heading level.

body.purpose: Long-form reading. Comfortable 16px with generous line-height.

label.purpose: Dates, reading times, tags, all metadata. Always muted.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: All state transitions — hover, focus, color shifts.

components.name: Subscribe Button
components.description: Primary CTA pill button. The only filled UI element on the page.
components.css: .ds-btn-subscribe { background: #191919; color: #f7f4ed; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-subscribe:hover { background: #333333; } .ds-btn-subscribe:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #191919; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Header navigation text links. Minimal, no underlines.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: #242424; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #191919; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #191919; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Post Title
components.description: Blog post titles in feed listings. Serif, bold, clickable.
components.html: The hidden leverage of good abstractions
components.css: .ds-post-title { color: #191919; font-family: Lora, Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 1.75rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-post-title:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-post-title:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #191919; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Post Meta
components.description: Date and reading time below post titles.
components.css: .ds-post-meta { color: #6b6b6b; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }

components.name: Tag List
components.description: Dot-separated plain text tags. No pills, no borders.
components.html: Systems · Design · Engineering
components.css: .ds-tag-list { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-tag { color: #6b6b6b; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tag:hover { color: #191919; } .ds-tag-sep { color: #6b6b6b; }

components.name: Newsletter Input
components.description: Email input for newsletter subscription. Pill-shaped, paired with Subscribe button.
components.css: .ds-newsletter-input { background: #f7f4ed; border: 1px solid #333333; border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #242424; width: 280px; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-newsletter-input::placeholder { color: #6b6b6b; } .ds-newsletter-input:focus { border-color: #191919; outline: none; }

narrative.overview:
The screen becomes a sheet of considered paper. Every choice serves a single premise: the words are the design. Typography carries the hierarchy, whitespace carries the rhythm, and warmth carries the invitation. The surface is not white — it is vellum, parchment, the off-white of a page you want to keep reading.

This system rejects corporate coldness, information overload, SaaS templates, and zero-personality defaults. It takes its cues from Medium's reading experience — the warmth, the generous spacing, the confidence that content alone is enough — while maintaining a distinct voice through considered serif typography and restraint that goes further than Medium itself.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, papery canvas that separates this from every cold-white tech blog
Serif display type for gravitas; sans-serif body for readability
Extreme restraint in color — black, warm grays, and the vellum itself are the entire palette
Pill-shaped CTAs as the single UI flourish
Content density is low; every element has room to breathe

rules.name: The No-Color Rule
rules.body: This system has no accent color in light mode. Black is the accent. The warmth of the vellum background is the only "color" the reader perceives.

rules.name: The Two-Font Rule
rules.body: Lora and Inter. There is no third font. Two families, deployed at different scales, is the entire typographic system.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If you add a box-shadow to any element, you are breaking the system. Elevation is expressed through typographic weight, size, and color contrast.

dos: Do use Vellum Warm (#f7f4ed) as the page background on every single page.
Do cap body text at 65ch line-length maximum.
Do use 48px+ spacing between post items.
Do keep tag/metadata styling at 13px muted gray with no visual embellishment.
Do use Lora only for display and headline levels.
Do make the entire post card a click target.
Do test dark mode with warm near-black (#1a1a1a).
donts: Don't use pure white (#ffffff) as a page background.
Don't add any saturated accent color in light mode.
Don't use card borders, card shadows, or card backgrounds for post listings.
Don't add tag pills with backgrounds or borders.
Don't use more than two font families.
Don't add a "Read more →" link to post cards.
Don't use dividers heavier than 1px or darker than #e8e4dc.
Don't use border-left accents, gradient text, or glassmorphism anywhere.
